method: Exact source profile comparison; not a model ranking or experimental test.

classes.same-effective-configuration: All executable configuration, reserves, origin and conditions match. Performance and cost have not been compared.
classes.distinct-auxiliary-routing: Same active primaries but different reserves, accelerators or disabled routes; do not merge manifests.
classes.distinct-operational-contract: Same model selectors and auxiliary routes but different operational conditions; do not merge contracts.
classes.distinct-resource-origin: Same selectors but different authorization route or credential origin; no equivalence of account access.

policy: Do not invent objective differences or claim improvement when the native configuration is identical.
